sequence.gate: Private independent repository, reproducible app, boundaries, CI exact SHA, generated evidence, protected preview
Public Core and SDK contracts, independent host, verified first-party model and serializable state
Trusted catalog module installed, consented, mounted, used, saved, reopened and disabled; negative security proofs
Authoritative server Core, single auth/data authority, actual teacher/student permissions and cross-device continuity
Different scientific domain uses same contracts without host changes
Human UX, physical devices, security, performance and protected release acceptance before public authorization

completionRule: No later milestone is accepted before the preceding gate has evidence. Documents and schemas do not count as working product.
